meta.name: listing-distribution
meta.description: Gets a product listed where buyers and crawlers look — directories, marketplaces, review sites, comparison pages, and aggregators. Use this to plan a submission push, choose which directories are worth the effort, prepare listing assets, build comparison and alternative pages, or manage presence on review platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品铺到买家常逛的目录与评测站,规划提报并维护口碑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在准备产品发布,想让更多买家从外部目录和评测站找到你。
copy.tagline_en: Get your product listed on the directories and review sites buyers browse.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and want it found on external directories and review sites.

howto.what: 装上后，它会帮你规划产品提交到哪些目录和市场，挑选值得投入的站点，准备统一的描述、标识、截图等素材，还能构建对比页面、管理评论平台的资料与回复。
howto.when: 当你要求规划目录提交、挑选目录、准备素材等时触发，也用于上架后的维护。

say.text: 帮我规划这款产品的目录提交清单，按买家是否使用来筛选。
say.note: 它会筛出买家真实在用的目录并排优先级。

say.text: 准备一套上架素材：不同长度的描述、标识、截图和定价摘要。
say.note: 它会生成各处提交都能复用的素材包。

say.text: 写一个我们与某竞品的对比页面，要诚实指出对方更强的方面。
say.note: 它会写出包含双方真实优劣的对比。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude helps you plan where to submit your product, choose worthwhile directories, prepare a reusable listing kit, build honest comparison pages, and manage your presence on review platforms.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a submission push, choose directories, or prepare listing assets, etc.

say_en.text: Plan a directory submission list for this product, filtering by buyer usage.
say_en.note: Claude filters directories by buyer usage and ranks them.

say_en.text: Prepare a listing kit: descriptions, logos, screenshots, pricing.
say_en.note: Claude generates a reusable asset kit for all submissions.

say_en.text: Write an honest comparison page vs. a competitor, noting where they excel.
say_en.note: Claude names where the competitor is actually better.
